run_densepose_cse_on_video_sequence: run densepose CSE inference on a DAVIS video sequence for human or animal subjects
create_cse_predictor: create a DensePose CSE predictor using a config path and pretrained weight URL
run_cse_inference: run CSE inference on a resized image and mask to get vertex clusters and embeddings
write_pfm_densepose_outputs: write densepose vertex clusters, embeddings, and norms to PFM files for each frame
save_vid_from_frames: save a list of frame images as an MP4 or GIF video file
